title: Our Happy Place | Designer Seaside Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Pet-friendly Seaside retreat steps from pools, fitness center, and playground, with bikes, gourmet kitchen, watchtower views, and quick beach access.
description_expanded: Our Happy Place Classic Seaside Home Steps to Pools, Beach, and Town Center Home Introduction Experience the best of Seaside living at Our Happy Place , a beautifully designed coastal retreat on the desirable east side of the community . With walkable access to pools, beach, dining, and recreation , plus stylish interiors and abundant outdoor spaces, this home is ideal for a relaxing and activity filled 30A getaway. Home Highlights • Pet Friendly - Up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less, non aggressive breeds only (approval and fee required) • Beach Access - 1 minute bike ride to Tupelo Street private beach access • Prime Location - Steps to Seaside pools, playground, and Croquet Lawn • 5 Taxi Bikes - Professionally serviced and ready to ride • Gourmet Kitchen - High-end Wolf and Sub Zero appliances • Sleeping for Multiple Guests - Four suites with ensuite baths plus bunk room • Top Floor Watchtower - Panoramic views of Seaside with Gulf glimpses • Outdoor Living - Covered porch, balcony with swing, and multiple private balconies • Dining for 8 - Plus breakfast bar seating for 2 • Entertainment - Sonos sound system and multiple TVs throughout • Third Floor Den - Additional living space near bunk room • Outdoor Shower - Enclosed with hot water • Propane Grill - Perfect for outdoor cooking • Parking for 2 Vehicles - Or 1 oversized vehicle • Full Access - Seaside pools, fitness center, and private beach entrances included Location Perks • 30 second walk to Seaside Fitness Center • Less than 100 yards to Adult Pool and Family Pool • 75 yards to playground and Croquet Lawn • 1 minute bike ride to Seaside dining, shopping, and tennis courts Home Details Our Happy Place blends timeless coastal design with modern comfort, featuring crisp white interiors accented by soft blues and natural tones inspired by the nearby Gulf. The open concept main level includes a gourmet kitchen, spacious dining area, and inviting living room that flows seamlessly to a covered porch. Upstairs, guests will find thoughtfully designed suites offering privacy and comfort, along with additional gathering space in the third floor den. The watchtower provides a unique vantage point with sweeping views, creating the perfect spot to unwind. With multiple outdoor living areas, easy beach access, and proximity to all that Seaside offers, this home delivers a truly elevated vacation experience. Know Before You Go • Mid stay clean required for reservations of 10 days or longer (included in rate) • Additional cleaning services available for an extra fee • Beach service available through Cabana Man with advanced reservations recommended • Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside with limited medical exceptions only • Pool heating schedule subject to change by HOA • Concierge services available including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, and more • Unauthorized pets may result in fines or eviction ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Suite 1 | TV, private balcony with cushioned bench swing and rocking chairs, ensuite bath with soaking tub, double vanity, and glass-door walk-in shower
2nd Floor Queen Suite | TV, private Juliette balcony, ensuite bath with shower/tub combo
3rd Floor King Suite 2 | TV, sleeps up to 4 in a king bed plus twin daybed and twin trundle, ensuite bath with soaking tub, and glass-door walk in shower
3rd Floor Bunk Suite | Sleeps up to 4 in two Twin/Twin Bunks, built in ladder and guard rail for top bunks, adjacent to den with TV, ensuite bath with shower/tub combo
